title: calendar_event
description: An event as GET /api/v1/calendar-feeds/events serves it (OpenSpec calendar-feeds, calendar-event-edits). The summary and location are written by people. rev, access and changedBy are set for an event of a connected calendar only.

start.description: {date, time?, tz?} like a task's due

end.description: {date, time?, tz?}; an all-day end is exclusive

rev.description: the version to send with a change

access.description: {update, delete, reason?}: whether OpenTodo may change or delete it, and why not

changedBy.description: {kind: assistant, name}: an assistant's change the user can still undo
